action_items: Backend suite ran with no tests collected (pytest exit 5); no API-bearing criterion is present.

The persisted portfolio-leetcode-stats check is stale for the animated implementation: it asserts the count before scrolling/animation settlement and should be updated or retired; the dedicated animated-progress check passed.

checks.criterion: Portfolio renders as a modern responsive one-page experience with a light white-and-black editorial theme
checks.name: portfolio-renders-editorial
checks.evidence: Local browser rerun passed at desktop and mobile viewports; portfolio page, ADNAN.PAL logo, hero heading, and mobile navigation toggle were visible.

checks.criterion: Primary navigation reaches the requested sections
checks.name: portfolio-navigation-sections
checks.evidence: Local browser rerun clicked section anchors and mobile About navigation successfully.

checks.criterion: Theme toggle works without breaking the page
checks.name: portfolio-theme-toggle
checks.evidence: Local browser rerun toggled the html dark class, retained the hero, and restored the light state.

checks.criterion: Deployment section covers AWS, Vercel, and Render
checks.name: portfolio-deployment-tabs
checks.evidence: Local browser rerun verified AWS, Vercel, and Render panels and their associated content.

checks.criterion: Project showcase preserves all six projects with animated card presentation
checks.name: portfolio-project-showcase
checks.evidence: Local browser rerun verified all six project cards and representative action links.

checks.criterion: Contact area provides presentation-only contact actions
checks.name: portfolio-contact-actions
checks.evidence: Local browser rerun verified email/social links, Hire Me mailto, and Copy email feedback.

checks.criterion: LeetCode section preserves the displayed profile stats
checks.name: portfolio-leetcode-stats
checks.evidence: Persisted check failed its immediate-count assertion with Easy45%0 because it does not scroll into view or wait for the animated count to settle; dedicated animated check passed.

checks.criterion: Hero text “Hi, I’m Adnan Pal” has visible staggered animation treatment
checks.name: portfolio-hero-staggered-heading
checks.evidence: Browser check verified aria-label complete text, four separate word elements (Hi,, I'm, Adnan, Pal), and all word elements settling to visible opacity.

checks.criterion: LeetCode progress has animated counts and progress bars
checks.name: portfolio-leetcode-animated-progress
checks.evidence: Browser check scrolled the section into view and verified total 62, counts Easy/Medium/Hard 28/31/3, and progress aria values 45/50/5 after animation settlement.
